mapper.insert: insert into comments(user_id, post_id, root_id, reply_id, reply_user_id, content) value (#{userId},#{postId},#{rootId}, #{replyId}, #{replyUserId}, #{content})
mapper.update: update comments set reply_count = reply_count + 1 where id=#{rootId}
mapper.select: select id, user_id, root_id, reply_id, reply_user_id, content, reply_count, create_time from comments where post_id=#{postId} and state=0 order by create_time asc, id asc
